Action Required: Enter when price flips trend and moves back above/below the key reaction level.
Entry Logic: Wait for a lower high/higher low to form on lower TFs, then enter as price breaks the 1-hour structure level again.
Target / Exit Strategy: Target the 1-hour swing level or the next major structural high/low (Final Boss).

Action Required: Monitor on a lower timeframe to identify when the "messy" pullback is ending.
Entry Logic: Anticipate the shakeout of FOMO traders; look for structure to shift back in the direction of the initial explosion.
Target / Exit Strategy: Hold and wait for the trend to realign; do not place trades during the middle of the pullback.

Action Required: Identify a breakout beyond the swing levels; do not trade this phase.
Entry Logic: Treat this as information or a "blueprint" rather than a signal to enter; wait for the breakout to settle.
Target / Exit Strategy: Use the high or low point of the indication as the future target level.

Action Required: Do not trade while price is ranging between a high and low with no indication.
Entry Logic: Price is "fighting" for position; discipline is required to wait for a breakout (indication).
Target / Exit Strategy: Stay away from the market to avoid rule-breaking structure.
